about.impact.title: Measurable Efficiency & Zero-Error Results
about.cta.card1.title: Are your company's BIM workflows slowing you down? Let's optimize them.
about.cta.card2.title: Are you an engineer who fell in love with Python? You belong here.
about.manifesto.box1_desc1: Relies heavily on brute-force human labor for data mapping, visual clash detection, and model updates.
about.manifesto.box1_desc2: This outdated approach wastes thousands of engineering hours, drains project budgets, and mathematically guarantees human error in complex deliverables.
about.manifesto.box2_desc1: Purchasing expensive, out-of-the-box software licenses (Revit/ACC) without custom API integration.
about.manifesto.box2_desc2: Forces your engineers to adapt to rigid software limitations, rather than adapting the software to your specific project needs. You pay for tools, not solutions.
about.manifesto.box3_desc1: We believe if a task is executed twice in Revit, it belongs to an automated Python or C# script.
about.manifesto.box3_desc2: We replace human error with code—reducing model auditing times from days to seconds while guaranteeing flawless output compliance for ISO 19650 and UNI 11337.
about.journey.p1_item1_desc: Managing complex European infrastructure projects exposed a critical industry failure. Highly skilled engineers waste up to 40% of their billable hours on repetitive data entry, parameter mapping, and manual quality control.
about.journey.p1_item2_desc: Relying on brute-force human labor for redundant tasks drains project budgets and mathematically guarantees data errors during high-stakes B2B tenders.
about.journey.p2_item1_desc: Rooted in the academic and technological hub of Padua, Italy, we refused to scale our operations through traditional headcount. We transitioned our entire methodology to code.
about.journey.p2_item2_desc: By integrating custom Python, C#, and Revit APIs directly into the core workflow, we replaced manual drafting with algorithmic automation—crushing processing times from days to seconds.
about.journey.p3_item1_desc: Today, pyBIM operates as the silent technical backbone for tier-one AEC firms across the DACH region and Italy.
about.journey.p3_item2_desc: We develop the custom software infrastructure required to multiply your project capacity without increasing overhead, guaranteeing absolute output compliance with ISO 19650, openBIM/IFC, and UNI 11337.
